notes.title: Merry XMAS, Machizzle is now FREE!
notes.content:
This comes with a ‘final’ patch to address compatibility. We’ve tested with headset such as Meta Quest Pro, PICO 4 or Pimax Crystal, that were not available when we created the game and we specifically didn’t add bindings for them. It works with SteamVR Input 2.0 just fine, which means there should be compatibility even for upcoming headset. At last, we’ve removed the editor and community levels functionality, as the backend has been offline for some time now. 

If you’re wondering why we did it. [url=https://www.infinite.cz]iNFINITE Production[/url] is a development studio and our primary revenue stream is from B2B collaborations, where we help companies incorporate XR technologies into their daily lives and workflows. Training, marketing, education, you name it. Check [url=https://www.infinite.cz/portfolio]our portfolio[/url]! However, in order to keep our skills from falling behind, we keep 1/3 of time to work on our own ‘internal’ or R&D projects. Machizzle was one such project. While we believe we’re quite highly skilled at creating things (and you can check this claim right away, did I mention Machizzle is now free?), we are not so good at self-promotion*. This meant that Machizzle was enjoyed by far less people than would probably enjoy it, if they knew about the game. And by offering Machizzle for free, we hope to fix that. 

If you haven’t played Machizzle in the past, give it a try now and if you like, be sure to spread the word that the game is now free! 

PS.; You can also let us know how you enjoy the game on our [url=discord.gg/hYUHqg8]Discord[/url], or wishlist our next game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284480/Soar/]Soar[/url].

* Being aware of that, we’ve hired a game marketing agency to help us with promotion. They ran away with our money, doing nothing to help the game and claiming they're "cannot guarantee the result". That probably made things even worse.

notes.title: Machizzle is Finally Available Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Machizzle is now available![/b][/h2]

We are so excited for you to try and go through Machizzle’s 80-level campaign. And to also spend time creating the most intricate VR puzzles and levels using the base materials the game already has. You have complete access to power-ups, different blocks, and the freedom to challenge yourself and other players online!

Enjoy enchanting 3D VR puzzle gameplay that bends the laws of physics with diverse campaigns, engrossing complexity, and a heart-wrenching story of a man, Rock, trying to save his friend wolf, Stone.

So if you are looking for a VR game to take you on a mysterious journey through ancient ruins to solve physics-based puzzles, then Machizzle is a perfect match for you!

Go check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301770/Machizzle/]store page[/url] of the most engrossing and immersive physics-based VR puzzler to start your 2021 with!

notes.title: Physics-bending puzzle game Machizzle is part of Steam Games Festival
notes.content:
Machizzle is a physics-bending puzzle game with a simple objective - get the ball to the goal. You need to use laws of physics in the first place, but you'll soon discover that can you can bend them a lot - using force fields to reflect your ball in exact 90 degrees angle, or using jump pads to get higher or even picking gravity altering powerups. Choose the right tools to get the job done.

[h2]Demo contents[/h2]
The demo features 28 levels and should last quite a few hours, even when you're a good logical thinker you definitely shouldn't be done under 2 hours! The first 21 levels have a logical progression, even that speed up from final game, the next 7 are more like a bonus content, with a selection of harder levels and tricky mechanics. After each level you'll be asked to judge the level both in terms of difficulty and fun-factor. This is optional, but we're testing several approaches to level design and want to know, which levels you consider most fun. The final game will feature several more blocks and even more physics bending. The number of finals levels depends on how many levels are we able to build that will be fun, but hopefully over 100. 

[h2]The story of Machizzle[/h2]
The development started in August 2018, when I was missing a seriously puzzle game for VR and decided to try to build one. As my company ([url=http://www.infinite.cz]iNFINITE Production[/url]) is mostly work-for-hire development team, we had only our spare time to work on the development. We've never build a puzzle game (or a full game, aside marketing demos) before, so a great deal of learning, trying things and iterating was done. And it's finally in a state we're confident about the product and invite all of you to try it. So hoping you'll have a great deal of fun, and if you do, be sure to let us know!

[h2]Get in touch![/h2]
We'd love to hear back from you and we will checking our discord frequently:
[url=https://discord.gg/vhF2pjt]https://discord.gg/vhF2pjt[/url]

You can also like our Facebook page and send us a message over there:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/Machizzle/]https://www.facebook.com/Machizzle/[/url]

So, have fun and we hope it's certainly not the last time we hear about you, and or you hear about us.
